question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Contrary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Similar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Contrary"** means opposite in nature, direction, or meaning. (विपरीत)
 
 
• **Example:** Her views are contrary to mine on this subject.
 
 
 
• **"Similar"** refers to something that is almost the same as something else; having a resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity, without being identical. (समान)
 
 
• **Example:** The two paintings are quite similar in style and technique.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Contrary' **is **'Similar'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Similar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Transformational** (परिवर्तनकारी): Relating to or involving transformation or change.
 
 
• **Example:** The transformational leader inspired the team to achieve great things.
 
 
 
• **Reverse** (उल्टा): Going in or turned toward the direction opposite to that previously stated.
 
 
• **Example:** He drove the car in reverse to back out of the driveway.
 
 
 
• **Forward** (आगे): In the direction that one is facing or traveling; toward the front.
 
 
• **Example:** She took a step forward to greet her friend.
